title: Rev5.7.1 Directed Observation & Context Projection

compatibility.policy: One current contract only. Previous Eyle sessions, queue databases, project memory and configuration are rejected rather than migrated or adapted.

architecture.main_llm: Owns task semantics, Investigation and stopping. It chooses capabilities and decides whether an objective frontier is material; Runtime never turns frontier presence into semantic debt.
architecture.runtime: Owns physical authority, deterministic tool execution, canonical ObservationResult projection, opaque snapshot-handle storage, ledgers, transactions, persistence and resource fuses. It validates and records objective coverage/frontiers without interpreting their relevance.
architecture.claim: One independent semantic review path grounded by typed coordinates across request, answer anchors, source Evidence, Runtime Facts and Investigation. Runtime validates coordinate existence; Claim decides what those coordinates establish.
architecture.grounded_outcomes: material_satisfaction is satisfied|gap|blocked. Physical blockage is a valid truthful outcome when supported by Runtime Facts; semantic gaps state required_property without prescribing tools.
architecture.investigation: Optional persistent semantic debt declared only by the Main LLM. Runtime mechanically preserves identity, goals, Evidence binding and legal transitions.
architecture.observation_map: Derived from ObservationLedger; Runtime Facts for Claim are bounded projections of objective current-job observations, not a second factual ledger.
architecture.tool_registry: TOOLS is the sole executable registry. Every capability exposes compact/full contracts plus a domain-neutral effect class (observe|execute|mutate). Progressive capability_index/active_tools remains selector-free.
architecture.terminal_capabilities: ExecutionContext records non-retryable tool failures for the current physical job and excludes those capabilities from later callable projections; this is physical reality, not semantic routing.
architecture.structured_transport: Agent and Claim require strict JSON Schema. Claim grounding arrays are non-empty in the canonical schema/parser contract; no downgrade, repair call or truncation retry exists.
architecture.state_ownership: ObservationLedger owns tool reality/replay/coverage; EvidenceLedger owns citable source Evidence; DecisionLedger owns decisions/rejection identity; LLMCallLedger owns logical/provider calls; WriteTransaction owns real mutations; ExecutionContext owns job resources/terminal capabilities/sandbox lifecycle.
architecture.sandbox: backend=auto prefers Docker and falls back to Bubblewrap. Docker uses one persistent disposable container per job with a writable sanitized project snapshot, network and package/toolchain freedom. The real workspace is never mounted read-write; only WriteTransaction can mutate it.
architecture.writes: One WriteTransaction owns proposal, dry-run, confirmation, apply, validation, failure and rollback. Sandbox mutations never authorize workspace writes.
architecture.final: One canonical object: answer, limitations and Main-selected evidence_ids. Claim receives only Evidence explicitly selected by Main in final or Investigation.
architecture.structural_relations: symbol_relations keeps query=relations as the local structural view and query=reachability as the query-shaped path view. Reachability resolves local/import bindings before global-name fallback and exposes only frontiers on the root-side coverage of the requested property.
architecture.observation_contract: Every executed tool result uses one canonical envelope: physical status fields plus observations, coverage, frontiers and handles. Empty optional observation fields are legal; tools are not forced to invent frontier state.
architecture.observation_handles: Opaque handles address bounded observation snapshots, not semantic conclusions. Handles persist in ObservationLedger for the job/session, are materialized through expand_observation(handle), and become stale when workspace_epoch changes.
architecture.directed_observation: Query-shaped observation brings the capability request closer to the objective property. Import/alias-aware reachability materializes complete paths when possible; unresolved frontier payloads are limited to the actual query coverage rather than project-global uncertainty.
architecture.context_projection: Canonical world/task state remains complete in ledgers. Main prompts receive a hot projection: bounded recent/pinned Evidence and Observation indexes, only the two most recent expanded tool contracts, and bounded current-delta tool results. Older capabilities remain callable through the compact capability index.
architecture.claim_projection: Claim grounding is projected by Main authority: final.evidence_ids plus Evidence explicitly attached to Investigation. Runtime validates IDs and freshness but does not infer semantic relevance.
